entities.name: UE information procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by the network to request the UE to report information.

entities.name: UEInformationRequest
entities.description: Message sent from network to UE to request information reporting.

entities.name: UEInformationResponse
entities.description: Message sent from UE to network containing the requested information.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that initiates the UE information procedure.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: The user equipment that responds to network information requests.

relations.description: The UE information procedure includes sending UEInformationRequest message.
The UE information procedure includes receiving UEInformationResponse message.
Network initiates the procedure by sending UEInformationRequest.
UE responds to the network request by sending UEInformationResponse.
